svg.text: Shape sweep v1, Stage 1 outlines (400 mm span, common scale) and the 3 references. Border: green = candidate, orange = 4 of 5 parts, grey = fewer, red = cancellation (twist number not credible, ratio below 0.25, a post-hoc cut). Twist = tolerance for R = 30 m (B45 as flown = 0.035 deg).
MODEL (AVL, inviscid). Stage-1 outlines are flat; T carries tip fins, B none. Not a flight result.
